issues.title: Server-authoritative match slice and command contract
issues.body:
## Outcome

Server-authoritative match slice and command contract.

## Assignment

- Workstream: backend
- Branch: `agent/backend-foundation`
- Brief: `agents/backend.md`
- Specification: `docs/backend/first-slice.md`
- Base commit and source manifest hash: to be pinned after repository selection.

## Scope

- [ ] Draft command, receipt, per-audience projection and deadline contracts for integration review.
- [ ] Implement the pure engine and Firebase adapter for the approved nine-seat Officer/Protection fixture.
- [ ] Prove idempotency, private/public boundaries, phase deadlines and reconnect recovery with executable evidence.

## Dependencies

- Shared contracts reviewed by Frontend and Game Balance.
- Exact private-disclosure and relevant resolution semantics settled for the chosen fixture.

## Acceptance

Follow the role brief and specification. Report only actual checks and measurements. A seeded nine-seat fixture with two controlled clients is not a new two-player mode. Preserve current rule overlays and secret-information boundaries.
